domains.responsibility: Browser-rendered task list interface with English controls
In-memory task data and task operations (add, complete, delete) without persistence

features.responsibility: Allow the user to add a new task to the list via an English-labeled control
Allow the user to mark an individual task complete via an English-labeled control
Allow the user to delete an individual task via an English-labeled control

requirements.description: The user can enter task text and submit it; a new task appears in the task list with the entered text and is not marked complete.

acceptances.description: Entering text in the task input and submitting adds a task with that exact text to the visible list, not shown as complete.
Submitting with empty input does not add a task.

requirements.description: Each individual task provides a control to mark it complete; a completed task is visibly indicated.

acceptances.description: Activating the complete control on a task marks only that task as complete with a visible indication; other tasks remain unchanged.

requirements.description: Each individual task provides a control to delete it; deleting removes that task from the list.

acceptances.description: Activating the delete control on a task removes only that task from the visible list; other tasks remain unchanged.

requirements.description: All user-facing controls and labels are in English.

acceptances.description: Every visible control and label of the task list is in English.

constraints.description: The existing native ESM workspace must be preserved; the task list runs within it.
This first iteration excludes editing existing tasks, bulk operations, filters, and persistence; tasks exist only in memory for the session.

relations.description: Marking a task complete is only possible if a task has been added.
Deleting a task is only possible if a task has been added.
